Container.Name: Waypoint
Container.Overview: Waypoint is a private learning log for turning an engineering growth plan into a sustainable daily habit. It stores all JSON data, media, sessions, and the authentication encryption key under one persistent /app/data directory. The exact JOURNEY_PUBLIC_URL is mandatory: set it to the LAN URL users will open (for example http://192.168.1.25:4173) before starting. The template runs the image as Unraid's non-root nobody:users (UID 99, GID 100) through --user=99:100; keep the appdata directory writable by that user.
Container.Requires: Set JOURNEY_PUBLIC_URL to the exact URL users will open before first start; the container refuses an all-interface bind without explicit Host/Origin trust configuration.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Container port 4173. Pick an unused host port if needed.

Config.Name: Waypoint data
Config.Description: Persistent data directory. It contains the store JSON, media, and auth.key. Keep this directory in backups.

Config.Name: JOURNEY_PUBLIC_URL (REQUIRED)
Config.Description: REQUIRED: exact URL users open, for example http://192.168.1.25:4173 or https://waypoint.example.com behind a reverse proxy. Do not leave blank; this controls trusted Host/Origin checks.

Config.Name: JOURNEY_SECURE_COOKIES
Config.Description: Optional true for HTTPS deployments. Leave empty to infer true from an https public URL and false for HTTP.

Config.Name: JOURNEY_TRUSTED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated exact Host aliases, including ports when present.

Config.Name: JOURNEY_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated exact http:// or https:// Origin aliases.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Logging level: silent, fatal, error, warn, info, debug, or trace.
